summary: Mr. Electric of Salt Lake City is an Established digital presence (Digital Maturity 74) with strong SEO basics and reputation. Measured evidence shows 318 reviews at 5 stars and a claimed profile, but homepage gaps limit local search context and mobile performance. The two deterministic findings are No structured data was detected on the homepage and Lighthouse mobile performance 61/100 with 3.7s LCP.

topOpportunities.title: Add LocalBusiness structured data for local search context
topOpportunities.evidence: Deterministic finding: No structured data was detected on the homepage. | Homepage signals: Structured data: not found and JSON-LD structured data blocks: 0
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Without structured data, search engines must infer business type, location, and services from page text alone. Adding Electrician/LocalBusiness schema could help reinforce the already-strong Lighthouse SEO 92/100 for local queries.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add LocalBusiness + Electrician JSON-LD to homepage and core service pages using the verified address 925 E 900 S Suite 201, Salt Lake City, UT 84105 and phone already detected (hasPhone: true). Include sameAs links to Google profile.

topOpportunities.title: Improve mobile performance - reduce LCP and JS blocking time
topOpportunities.evidence: Lighthouse mobile performance: 61/100; largest contentful paint: 3.7s (3727ms) | Lighthouse metrics: totalBlockingTimeMs 1350 and interactiveMs 4351 and largestContentfulPaintMs 3727
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Mobile Quality is measured as Fair with LCP well above 2.5s and total blocking time 1350ms, which could make service pages slower to become interactive on phones despite 57 internal links aiding navigation.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Prioritize mobile speed fixes flagged in Lighthouse: address 1.8s JavaScript execution time and 3.0s main-thread work, reduce unused CSS (Est savings of 44 KiB), improve image delivery (Est savings of 643 KiB) and cache lifetimes (Est savings of 3,610 KiB). Re-test LCP target.

topOpportunities.title: Fix accessibility contrast and heading/link issues
topOpportunities.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility: 88/100 | Lighthouse failures include: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio and Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order and Links do not have a discernible name and Links do not have descriptive text: 4 links found
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Accessibility 88/100 is good but not excellent; contrast and heading/link failures could affect usability for some visitors and are often low-effort fixes that also help SEO clarity.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Fix accessibility quick wins: correct heading order across templates, improve color contrast ratios, and add discernible/descriptive text to the 4 affected links. Verify with a second Lighthouse run.

topOpportunities.title: Align sitemap and verify booking conversion tracking
topOpportunities.evidence: Crawled 10 same-site pages (truncated: true) but sitemapPageCount: 2 | Detected stack: GA4 with no other measurement tools listed
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: A sitemap covering only 2 pages while 10 same-site pages were crawled could limit discovery efficiency; verifying GA4 tracks the existing booking link ensures the 100% high-rating review traffic can be measured end-to-end.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Ensure sitemap reflects all indexed service pages (10 pages crawled vs 2 in sitemap) and confirm GA4 booking/estimate conversions are tracked for the detected Online booking or request link and Online estimates offer.
